# Ro Khanna Financial Disclosure Explorer

> Independent, source-linked transcription of U.S. House financial disclosures for Ro Khanna, covering 2016–2026.

Use the annual Markdown or facts JSON pages for compact answers. Use the API for complete holdings and transaction arrays. Dollar figures are statutory ranges, not exact values; household disclosures can include a spouse and dependent children.

## Primary resources

- [Latest annual filing](https://www.rokhanna.money/): Human-readable overview with methodology and sources.
- [All reported stock trades](https://www.rokhanna.money/stock-trades/): Cross-year transaction analysis.
- [API documentation](https://www.rokhanna.money/api/v1/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of the read-only API.
- [Year index](https://www.rokhanna.money/api/v1/years.json): Canonical, Markdown, and JSON URLs for every filing year.
- [Issuer index](https://www.rokhanna.money/api/v1/issuers.json): Reviewed company identities that join raw filing-name variants.
- [Issuer comparison API](https://www.rokhanna.money/api/v1/compare?entity=NVDA&years=2024,2025): Cross-year reported bounds, evidence, and comparability warnings.
- [Full LLM context](https://www.rokhanna.money/llms-full.txt): Expanded annual summaries and citation guidance.
- [Data methodology](https://github.com/kanetronv2/khanna-disclosure-explorer/blob/main/data/README.md): Normalized schema, caveats, and audit process.

## Common question pattern

Question: Did Ro Khanna's reported NVIDIA holdings increase or decrease from 2024 to 2025?
Use [https://www.rokhanna.money/api/v1/compare?entity=NVDA&years=2024,2025](https://www.rokhanna.money/api/v1/compare?entity=NVDA&years=2024,2025). Report the direction of the disclosed lower and upper bounds separately from actual holdings, and carry forward the returned 2025 comparability warning.

## Citation and interpretation

- Cite a canonical year page for aggregate calculations.
- Cite an evidence record's `url` for a holding or transaction, then verify consequential claims against its linked filing page.
- Preserve open-ended ranges and year-specific caveats. Do not describe the calculated totals as certified personal net worth.
- Treat OCR and model-assisted transcription as fallible; unresolved readings remain explicit in the data.
